rawBridgePoolProof.previousDefect: The prior lifetime repair used long-lived GlobalDataVault TryLockBuffer relocation pins for native-exported audio bridge pointers. That protected raw pointers but could block or defer DataVault arena growth for the lifetime of the audio bridge.
rawBridgePoolProof.failClosedBehavior: If sourceChannels is outside [1,2], Initialize records NativeAudioKernelBridgeStatus.SharedStateInvalid when an existing ring can accept telemetry, then returns without allocation, descriptor registration, or disposing the current bridge. Oversized capacity requests clamp to the fixed 65,536-frame SPSC bridge budget before raw allocation, and both managed and native descriptor validation reject capacities above 65,536 frames. If any raw pool allocation fails, Initialize calls Dispose and leaves the ring uncreated; descriptor creation and registration fail closed. C# bridge validation re-reads SharedState capacity/mask/guards/source-channel metadata before P/Invoke and returns SharedStateInvalid before P/Invoke if that metadata no longer matches the descriptor/native contract. SourceChannels is copied into the immutable descriptor and native callback uses ringBuffer.sourceChannels; if SharedState source-channel metadata differs from the descriptor, C# validation and native validation both reject it before registration. Register and clear use new AndGetStatus exports, so managed code reads the exact mutation result instead of racing through callback health status. If Dispose asks native clear and native still reports Active or Busy while H8Memory is initialized, TryDispose returns false, raw buffers are retained, Initialize blocks reallocation, and PlayerCriticalProceduralAudioRenderer keeps the _sampleRingBuffer owner instead of losing the only managed retry handle. PluginUnavailable is the normal failed-clear fallback that releases the managed-side raw pool because no native plugin can retain the descriptor. If H8Memory is already shut down, raw pointers are nulled instead of retained because the backing memory has already been reaped; TryResolveRingViews also refuses to create NativeArray views after H8Memory shutdown. Managed shared-state cursor reads reject raw indices outside [0, capacityFrames) instead of masking corruption through capacityMask; the producer records TelemetryStatusSharedStateInvalid and triggers the fixed dump route. Hot telemetry writes go to the stable raw telemetry ring and do not acquire a DataVault writer fence, managed thread, managed I/O, or Thread.MemoryBarrier. Fault/shutdown paths best-effort mirror the raw telemetry ring into BufferID.AudioFrameRingTelemetry, and both dump/mirror readers validate sequence and StateHash before copying a 64-byte DTO. If the DataVault mirror lock cannot be acquired because the vault is unavailable, stale, or fenced by compaction, the raw binary dump still uses the latest stable raw telemetry entries and the writer does not block. Native dump export now performs the bounded C file write directly and returns write success/failure. C# rearms _telemetryDumpQueued in a finally scope after every native write attempt. If native callback depth cannot drain during register/clear, the native mutation gate reopens without clearing g_hasSharedRingBuffer; status restores to Active|Busy when an old descriptor is still owned or Cleared|Busy when no descriptor exists, and the call returns instead of spinning forever.
rawBridgePoolProof.architecturalCost: The native callback and hot telemetry writer now retain only stable H8Memory raw-pool pointers. GlobalDataVault no longer carries long-lived relocation pins for Frames, SharedState, DumpBytes, or the hot telemetry ring. DataVault remains the cold identity/mirror lane for BufferID.AudioFrameRingTelemetry; its mirror can be stale until a fault dump or normal Dispose copies the raw ring.

nativeMutationGateProof.previousDefect: Native RegisterSharedRingBuffer and ClearSharedRingBuffer disabled g_hasSharedRingBuffer before WaitForProcessCallbacksToDrain succeeded. A drain timeout could therefore leave an old descriptor allocated but no longer reachable by ProcessCallback.
nativeMutationGateProof.behavior: Register/clear now set g_callbackMutationGate before drain. ProcessCallback increments depth and exits before bridge mixing while that gate is set. failClosedProof: Invalid descriptor -> IsDescriptorValid returns status bits and TryRegisterWithRetryGate returns false without calling TryClear.

Shared-state metadata mismatch -> IsDescriptorValid returns SharedStateInvalid before P/Invoke if capacity/mask/guards/source-channel values in SharedState do not match the immutable descriptor contract.

Source-channel stride corruption -> SourceChannels is frozen in the descriptor at byte 48 and native callback reads ringBuffer.sourceChannels; a later SharedState SourceChannelsSlot mutation cannot change callback frame stride after validation.
Plugin unavailable -> status PluginUnavailable, false return, no throw.

Android/Quest native binary missing or native plugin importer invalid -> NativePluginMatrixValidator hard-fails actual player builds; if a non-standard route bypasses build preflight, the runtime bridge still fails closed through PluginUnavailable.
Invalid sourceChannels -> Initialize records SharedStateInvalid telemetry when possible and returns without allocation, descriptor registration, or disposing the current bridge.
P/Invoke load race -> guarded catch only on cold bridge calls, converts native load failure to PluginUnavailable status.
Invalid capacity state -> Initialize disposes or read/write paths return false/zero state.
Ring overflow -> TryWriteInterleaved records overflow telemetry and returns false.

Corrupt shared-state cursor -> TryReadSharedFrameIndex rejects raw ReadIndex/WriteIndex outside [0, capacityFrames), records TelemetryStatusSharedStateInvalid, triggers dump, and returns false/zero state instead of masking corruption through capacityMask.

Non-finite sample -> sample clamps to 0, raw telemetry records NonFinite without acquiring a DataVault writer fence, dump bytes are copied from the raw 300-entry ring into fixed H8Memory raw bytes and passed to native binary dump writer.
Telemetry dump buffer missing or wrong DTO size -> RequestTelemetryDump returns without allocation or exception.
Telemetry DataVault mirror lock unavailable -> raw dump still proceeds; DataVault mirror can be stale until the next fault/shutdown mirror attempt.
Native dump write succeeded or failed -> C# dump gate resets in finally after the write attempt; no detached native dump worker remains.

Raw bridge buffer allocation failure for Frames/SharedState/DumpBytes -> Initialize disposes, native registration is not attempted, and the system remains silent instead of exporting unstable pointers.

Native callback-depth drain stuck during register/clear -> mutation gate reopens, old descriptor ownership is retained if present, Busy marks the failed mutation, and the call returns after kDrainSpinLimit instead of infinite spin.
TryClear after native clear returns false when status still contains Active or Busy.

Dispose after failed native clear, including Active or Busy, returns false from TryDispose, retains raw bridge buffers, keeps the renderer _sampleRingBuffer owner alive, and makes Initialize return before new allocation only while H8Memory is initialized, preventing use-after-free and leaked raw ownership against a callback that already copied the descriptor.

Late Dispose after H8Memory shutdown -> native plugin clear is attempted, but failed-clear retention is disabled because the backing memory is already reaped; raw pointers are nulled without calling FreeRaw into an uninitialized tracker.
TryResolveRingViews after H8Memory shutdown -> returns false before creating NativeArray views over stale raw pointers.
